name: 518-plus
description: Process and temporarily share files with 518.PLUS.

interface.longDescription: Process, convert, compress, format, bundle, and temporarily share files with 518.PLUS. This plugin exposes a fixed set of 518.PLUS first-party file tools through MCP. It does not expose the third-party Tool Market. Files are processed in your connected 518.PLUS account, and generated files or share links are temporary and follow your account's retention and download limits.
defaultPrompt: Share the attached file with a temporary link.
Compress this image and give me the result.
Merge these PDF files in the order I attached them.

positive.description: Create a temporary share link for an attached file.
positive.prompt: Share the attached PDF with a temporary link.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a temporary 518.PLUS result containing the unchanged PDF and return a human-viewable result link.

positive.prompt: Compress this attached PNG while keeping it suitable for sharing.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a compressed image as a temporary 518.PLUS result without modifying the source file.

positive.prompt: Put this screenshot in a clean 1:1 frame for a social post.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the screenshot-formatting tool with the requested aspect ratio and return the generated image.

positive.prompt: Merge these two attached PDFs in attachment order.
positive.expected_behavior: Return one merged PDF whose page order follows the input attachment order.

positive.description: Convert multiple images into a PDF.
positive.prompt: Turn these attached images into one PDF in attachment order.
positive.expected_behavior: Return one PDF containing the attached images in the same order.

negative.description: Digital-credit purchasing is outside the public plugin surface.
Third-party Tool Market discovery and execution are not exposed by this plugin.
negative.prompt: Search the 518 Tool Market for a third-party OCR tool and run it.

negative.description: Permanent storage is unsupported because 518.PLUS plugin results are temporary.
negative.prompt: Store this attached file permanently with no expiry.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial 518.PLUS plugin submission with a fixed first-party MCP surface for file processing and temporary sharing.
